headline: Square-metre studio strapped to tree in "exaggerated response" to office rental prices
context: German architecture studio Opposite Office has created a one-square-metre treehouse to work from, fixed to a tree at the Bauhaus University campus in Weimar. Opposite Office designed the compact tree-bound structure, named Baumhaus Office, in response to high office rental prices

sources.name: Dezeen
sources.summary: German architecture studio Opposite Office has created a one-square-metre treehouse to work from, fixed to a tree at the Bauhaus University campus in Weimar. Opposite Office designed the compact tree-bound structure, named Baumhaus Office, in response to high office rental prices in Munich, Germany, where the studio was previously based.
